Excluding FX gain (Bt107m), gain on derivatives (Bt7m), inventory write down provision ( Bt61m) and doubtful debts (Bt54m), core profit would be Bt103m, down 53% YoY and 33% QoQ . Core profit came in around 40% below our estimate and below the market expectation range of Bt130–180m., due to heavier SG&A than assumed. Result highlights Revenue totaled Bt 4.9bn, down 6% YoY but up 2 % QoQ (in US dollar terms flattish YoY but up 4% QoQ to US$ 156m). Sales of microelectronics fell by 19% YoY and 4% QoQ (down 19% YoY and 4% QoQ for Lamphun-based operations and down 21% YoY and 6% QoQ for China-based plants). Sales of ICs rose 20% YoY and 10% QoQ (up 5% YoY and 5% QoQ for Ayutthaya -based plants while up 113% YoY and 30% QoQ for China plants). Sales of micro -display and RFID products rose 4% YoY and 31% QoQ. GM was 9.3% in 1Q26, against 10.1% in 1Q25 and 5.5% in 4Q25. SG&A to sales was 8.9%, against 8% in 1Q25 and 6.8% in 4Q25 (higher R&D expenses). Outlook US manufacturing PMI has moved back into expansion territory, with recent readings at 52.5 in Jan -Apr 2026. This marks a clear shift from a prolonged contraction phase toward early -cycle recovery. Early signs of recovery are emerging across both EMS and OSAT segments, driven by key customer orders and EV -related demand. We continue to expect gradual recovery ahead, although supply tightness in certain components remains a risk. We expect core profit to drop YoY in 2Q26 but slightly rise QoQ. What’s changed? We have maintained our 2026 core profit forecast for now. Recommendation HANA’s bottom-out story is no longer straight forward. The QoQ decline in 1Q26 core profit suggests the recovery is still fragile. The stock price has already re -rated significantly on expectations of earnings bottom out and the emerging AI -related narrative tied to new solid -state cooling customer opportunities such as Phononic. Nevertheless, we believe meaningful earnings contribution from the AI theme is unlikely before 2H27, making the current re -rating more story -driven than supported by fundaments at this stage. August 20, 2026

[โลโก้: Maybank Securities]

Tiger Insight

HANA : Positive outlook in PMS/HTI/OSAT biz

Hana Microelectronics PCL (HANA TB, CP THB47.0, BUY, TP THB52.0) Analyst Meeting Key Takeaways (2Q26)

Analyst :
Yugi Takeshima, IAA
Yugi.Takeshima@maybank.com
(66) 2658 5000 ext. 1530

Meeting came with an overall positive tone.

Lower PMS Korea losses likely in 2H26: improving market conditions are leading to steady increase in orders for Si/SiC products in 2H26; HANA is developing SST for AI/DC infrastructure and products in other applications, which could be launched by mid-FY27 (upside risk to our forecast).

Key Highlights :
- Thai OSAT biz recovery to extend into FY27: demand outlook remains strong from existing customers; HANA is also seeing one of the highest levels of NPI activity from customers its ever seen - HANA will raise CAPEX to support this segment even though 2Q26 u-rates were at 63% only.
- Phononic/AI Oscilloscope deals on track: qualifications are undergoing approval; mass production to begin in 3Q26, and significant sales contribution likely in 4Q26, with the machinery bottleneck to be resolved within 1Q27. Order volume is very robust.
- US Ohio (RFID) to return to profitability by 4Q26: HANA has maintained their guidance; new capacity increase of 60-80% (with secured deal) will support their yields and will return to profitability after a year of losses.

Our view: we see upside to our FY26/27 core profit forecast on lower-than-expected losses in PMS and OSAT upcycle (we currently forecast IC sales/margin to drop in FY27); maintain BUY on strong 2H26 and FY27 growth.

knowledge.heading: HANA — บทวิเคราะห์รายบริษัท: S__98983953
knowledge.content:
หลักทรัพย์: Hana Microelectronics (HANA.BK, HANA TB)

ย่อหน้านำ: "Following our first take on HANA's 2Q26 results, which saw better-than-expected margins, we raise our GM for FY26/27E to 10.6%/12.2% (from 9.1%/11.6%) but keep FY28E at 12.3%, reflecting positive operating leverage kicking in earlier than expected on a better loading volume.

This is mainly driven by a recovery in the existing (non-AI) business, which showed Q/Q improvement across both PCBA Assembly (Lamphun +4%; Jiaxing +9%) and Integrated Circuit revenue (led by +23% at Ayutthaya) — three plants that together account for ~80% of group revenue.

However, we also raise our SG&A assumptions to reflect potentially higher expenses as the group takes on new AI-related business (Phononic thermoelectric cooling and PCBA for optical transceiver oscilloscopes), likely to commence low-volume production in 3Q26.

We maintain our OW rating with a higher rolled-forward Dec-27 PT of Bt53 (from Bt45), pegged to a higher multiple of 27x (from 25x) to reflect a quicker-than-expected recovery from existing businesses."

2Q gross margin rose +3ppts Q/Q to 10.7% on higher loading volume from HANA's existing, entirely non-AI business.

HANA is involved in two AI-related projects: (i) thermoelectric cooling (TEC) for optical engines, and (ii) oscilloscopes (high-density PCBA) for 1.6T optical testing.

Both are for US-based customers and offer HANA exposure to strong AI networking demand.

Management noted the oscilloscope project sits well within the group's bread-and-butter expertise and expects it to scale quickly to a top-5 customer by 2027 (implying >US$250mn revenue, or ~8% of FY25 revenue).

PMS revenue doubled Q/Q in 2Q26 (off a low base), supporting our easing-overhang thesis as management tightens cost control and targets a new SiC application in data centre grid power.

**การตีความความเสี่ยงต่อผลตอบแทน:** จากราคาเข้า 37.75 บาท ความเสี่ยงอยู่ที่ 1.75 บาท (-4.6%) ขณะที่ผลตอบแทนเป้าหมายแรกอยู่ที่ 1.00 บาท (+2.6%) และเป้าหมายที่สองที่ 2.25 บาท (+6.0%) — **อัตราส่วน risk-reward ที่เป้าหมายแรกต่ำกว่า 1:1** ซึ่งหมายความว่าการเทรดนี้ต้องมีอัตราชนะสูงจึงจะคุ้ม นักลงทุนควรพิจารณาถือไปถึงเป้าหมายที่สองเพื่อให้ risk-reward เหมาะสมกว่า

**บริบทเชิงพื้นฐาน:** HANA ปรากฏอยู่ในรายชื่อหุ้นธีมที่ **KSS แนะนำในกลุ่มชิ้นส่วนอิเล็กทรอนิกส์ที่ได้จิตวิทยาบวกจาก US Bond Yield ที่ลดลง** ร่วมกับ DELTA และ KCE ซึ่งสอดคล้องกับธีม Decoupling Play ของ BLS ที่ชี้ว่าหุ้นส่งออกชิ้นส่วนอิเล็กทรอนิกส์แข็งกว่าตลาด อย่างไรก็ตาม **โฟลเดอร์นี้ไม่มีบทวิเคราะห์ปัจจัยพื้นฐานของ HANA** จึงไม่มีข้อมูลผลประกอบการ ราคาเป้าหมายเชิงพื้นฐาน หรือประมาณการกำไรให้อ้างอิง นักลงทุนที่จะเข้าตามสัญญาณนี้ควรตระหนักว่าเป็นการเทรดตามเทคนิคล้วน ๆ

ในการประมาณการผลประกอบการของ HANA ประมาณการรายได้แต่ละโรงงานในสกุล USD จากฐาน Run-rate ไตรมาส 1/2569
